title: bus_client no longer masks exit 3 when it starts the bus, once the bus loser exits quietly
intention: _spawn in bus_client/remote.py starts the bus unit without -p SuccessExitStatus=3, and its docstring and note say a second bus exits 0 quietly, so a bus loser that regresses to the loud exit 3 reads as a failed unit again. BUILDS AFTER ac71d984ebda LANDS ON MAIN: until the bus loser exits 0, the flag is correct.
why: ac71d984ebda (branch ac71d984ebda-build, tip 7718b16a2, queued with akienasus) makes a second bus exit 0 quietly, as b38af5fd1852 did for the ground loop, per Akien's Q#93 answer (outline 5.3.5.2.1; the bus is CC's read of it). cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py:229 still passes -p SuccessExitStatus=3 when it starts the bus (_spawn), its docstring at line 205 names the flag, and its note at line 243 says 'the flock decides; loser exits 3'. After ac71 those are stale and the flag would hide a regression to the loud exit.
traces_to: Law 5 (the thing and its story may not contradict) and Law 7 (a regression to a loud exit must not be hidden).
how: AFTER ac71d984ebda IS ON MAIN: delete the '-p', 'SuccessExitStatus=3' pair from _spawn's systemd-run argv; reword the docstring at line 205 and the note at line 243 to say a second bus exits 0 quietly. One proof reads the function's source with ast and the file's text, so it runs on any OS. Rebase over akiendelllinux's 5370 FIXME first (it edits _spawn, _detached and _setsid in the same file).

clauses.claim: _spawn's systemd-run argv no longer carries -p SuccessExitStatus=3, where it did
remote.py no longer says the bus's second copy exits 3, in its docstring or notes, where it said so in two places

decisions.text: D1: remove the flag and reword the docstring and the note in remote.py; built only after ac71d984ebda is on main.
D2: one proof reading the source, one tooth per clause; red first, and red on a hollow build.

out: akiendelllinux's 5370 FIXME (it lands first or is rebased over)

measured.saw: remote.py _spawn passes '-p', 'SuccessExitStatus=3' in its systemd-run argv (line 229); the docstring at line 205 names 'SuccessExitStatus=3' and the note at line 243 says 'the flock decides; loser exits 3'. On current main the bus loser still exits EXIT_HELD=3 (bus/server.py), so today the flag is correct; the bus loser exits 0 only on ac71d984ebda-build (7718b16a2), which has not landed.
measured.how: read remote.py 203-245; read bus/server.py serve() on main and on origin/ac71d984ebda-build
